mapper.sql: id, run_id, plan_generation, node_id, node_attempt, segment_sequence, state, context_version, run_control_version, claim_epoch, scheduler_version, claimed_by, lease_expires_at, next_visible_at, runnable_since, dispatch_defer_reason, payload_json::text AS payload_json, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alphafrog_agent_run_work_item (run_id, plan_generation, node_id, node_attempt, segment_sequence, state, context_version, run_control_version, claim_epoch, scheduler_version, claimed_by, lease_expires_at, next_visible_at, runnable_since, payload_json) SELECT #{item.runId}, #{item.planGeneration}, #{item.nodeId}, #{item.nodeAttempt}, #{item.segmentSequence}, COALESCE(#{item.state}, 'RUNNABLE'), #{item.contextVersion}, #{item.runControlVersion}, COALESCE(#{item.claimEpoch}, 0), COALESCE(#{item.schedulerVersion}, 'DUAL_POOL_V1'), #{item.claimedBy}, #{item.leaseExpiresAt}, COALESCE(#{item.nextVisibleAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{item.runnableSince}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(CAST(#{item.payloadJson} AS jsonb), '{}'::jsonb) WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM alphafrog_agent_run_service_lease lease_row WHERE lease_row.run_id = #{item.runId} AND lease_row.owner_instance_id = #{ownerInstanceId} AND lease_row.fencing_token = #{fencingToken} AND lease_row.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (run_id, plan_generation, node_id, node_attempt, segment_sequence) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM alphafrog_agent_run_work_item WHERE scheduler_version = #{schedulerVersion} AND state IN ('RUNNABLE', 'RESUMABLE') AND next_visible_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY next_visible_at, id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM alphafrog_agent_run_work_item WHERE scheduler_version IN ('DUAL_POOL_V1', 'DUAL_POOL_V2') AND state IN ('RUNNABLE', 'RESUMABLE') AND next_visible_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY COALESCE((SELECT c.dispatch_served_round FROM alphafrog_agent_run_coordination c WHERE c.run_id = alphafrog_agent_run_work_item.run_id), 0), next_visible_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM alphafrog_agent_run_work_item WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND state NOT IN () ORDER BY plan_generation, node_attempt, segment_sequence, id

SELECT FROM alphafrog_agent_run_work_item wi JOIN alphafrog_agent_run r ON r.id = wi.run_id WHERE r.scheduler_version = #{schedulerVersion} AND wi.state NOT IN () ORDER BY wi.run_id, wi.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alphafrog_agent_run_work_item wi JOIN alphafrog_agent_run r ON r.id = wi.run_id WHERE r.scheduler_version = #{schedulerVersion} AND wi.state NOT IN ()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alphafrog_agent_run_work_item WHERE state NOT IN ()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alphafrog_agent_run_work_item WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND state NOT IN ()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alphafrog_agent_run_work_item WHERE scheduler_version = #{schedulerVersion} AND state NOT IN ()
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(unfinished), 0) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS unfinished FROM alphafrog_agent_run_work_item WHERE state NOT IN () GROUP BY run_id ) per_run

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_work_item SET state = 'CLAIMED', claim_epoch = claim_epoch + 1, claimed_by = #{newOwner}, lease_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt}, dispatch_defer_reason = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE AND state IN ('CLAIMED', 'EXECUTING') AND claim_epoch = #{expectedClaimEpoch} RETURNING claim_epoch
mapper.update: UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_work_item SET state = 'EXECUTING', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE AND state = 'CLAIMED' AND claim_epoch = #{claimEpoch} AND claimed_by = #{claimedBy}

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_work_item SET state = 'EXECUTION_FAILED', payload_json = payload_json || jsonb_build_object('executionFailure', COALESCE(#{reason}, '')), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE AND state = 'EXECUTING' AND claim_epoch = #{claimEpoch} AND claimed_by = #{claimedBy}

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_work_item SET lease_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE AND state IN ('CLAIMED', 'EXECUTING') AND claim_epoch = #{claimEpoch} AND claimed_by = #{claimedBy}

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_work_item SET state = 'CANCELED', payload_json = payload_json || jsonb_build_object('cancelReason', COALESCE(#{reason}, '')), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE AND state NOT IN () AND run_control_version = #{runControlVersion} AND claim_epoch = #{claimEpoch}

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_work_item SET state = 'STALE', payload_json = payload_json || jsonb_build_object('staleReason', COALESCE(#{reason}, '')), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE AND state NOT IN () AND context_version = #{contextVersion} AND run_control_version = #{runControlVersion}
UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_work_item SET dispatch_defer_reason = #{reason}, next_visible_at = #{nextVisibleAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE AND state IN ('RUNNABLE', 'RESUMABLE')
UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_work_item SET dispatch_defer_reason = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE AND state IN ('RUNNABLE', 'RESUMABLE')
